problem: A heavyweight self-hosted proof rebuilt unchanged compiled dependencies after Python, documentation or render-only edits, wasting runner time and increasing local machine load.
invariant: Classify proof cost before reserving the heavy runner. Reuse compiled outputs only when a deterministic fingerprint of every binary-contract input matches and the expected binaries still exist; otherwise fail closed to a fresh build. Keep current-revision data preparation, runtime evidence and exact-SHA validation independent from compile reuse.
evidence: Passo Giau M3 Embark terrain proof #64 established the heavy C3 baseline before fingerprinted reuse
do_not_copy: Passo Giau paths, camera coordinates or proof variant names
failure_behavior: Unknown or empty specialized change sets are heavy. Missing cache state, fingerprint mismatch, missing expected binaries or dependency drift forces a fresh build; it must never silently downgrade required compile evidence.
